gate_or_program: Bellweather Alternate website-role scenario construction after L-234
bounded_question: What one-world circumstance mechanism can make Bellweather Alternate's BEFORE / POSSIBILITY role legible through her own unresolved human agency rather than world spectacle, threshold symbolism, relationship repetition or explanatory props?
controlled_inputs: Alternate remains the exact L-231 recognizable adult person; no identity reroll is implied.
One specific circumstance must already exist before Alternate responds.
The image must preserve at least two materially different believable next human responses.
No one in the scene may be posed as waiting for Alternate to perform a prescribed role.
No baked-in text, slogans, logos, labels or readable signage/prop lettering.
The scene must work without destination spectacle, literal threshold geometry or creator/operator metaphor.
excluded_variables: new Alternate face, anatomy or costume authority
heroic rescue, danger or crisis that makes one response morally mandatory
portal, doorway, path-fork, train-departure or other transition iconography carrying the meaning of possibility

local_result.summary: Select INTERRUPTED INTENTION as the scenario mechanism: Alternate is already engaged in an ordinary human activity when a low-stakes, socially legible circumstance changes what matters. Her attention registers the interruption before action, while continuing, engaging, assessing or redirecting remain plausible.

survivors_or_closure.reason: Keeps possibility inside Alternate's attention and agency; does not require world spectacle, symbolic passage or a pre-scripted relationship.

recommended_incumbent.first_eligible_visual_carrier: An ordinary neighborhood public-space moment with a minor practical disruption already in progress. Preferred first test: Alternate is off-center and mid-stride when a low stack of empty market baskets tips and one slides into her path while the nearby vendor is occupied gathering the others; another passerby simply routes around. Alternate has noticed but has not reached or committed.
recommended_incumbent.required_branching: At minimum, the still must leave stop/assist, briefly assess or steady something, route around and continue as credible next responses without visually privileging one as the correct outcome.
recommended_incumbent.presentation_variables: Exact public setting, weather, time of day, basket/crate material, background adults, wardrobe and lighting remain carrier variables. The market is a first test carrier, not Alternate anatomy or mandatory world.

alternates.reason: Can preserve open response but repeats L-226's interaction/relationship territory too closely.
Moves too much meaning into a prop and risks mystery-story shorthand.
Makes path, threshold or destination carry possibility and drifts toward Mediate or the failed Study 01 spectacle boundary.

rejections: A visually obvious choice menu or fork in the road.
A stranger directly soliciting Alternate so that she reads as helper/hostess.
Emergency, danger or distress that makes intervention the only sympathetic response.
A highly cinematic destination that announces adventure before her agency is legible.
A staged invitation, performance or creator metaphor that makes her look like the app/Director.

judgment.design_sol_view: Interrupted intention is the smallest clean mechanism that extends L-234. It preserves ordinary personhood, allows skepticism/discovery/readiness from L-225 to remain available, and tests whether BEFORE / POSSIBILITY can survive without spectacle or relationship exposition.
judgment.director_view_or_delegation: Director agreed to proceed with scenario construction after accepting L-234. Detailed contextual design judgment for this bounded construction is exercised by Design Sol under the standing in-lane delegation.

mechanical: No site/public or app source changed.
Scenario mechanism derived from already-frozen L-231/L-225/L-226/L-234 authority.
visual: L-231 establishes the exact website-facing person and unresolved selective attention.
L-225 establishes Identity/Everyday/Relational/Skeptical/Discovery/Ready and circumstance -> attention -> response -> choice.
L-226 demonstrates useful social ambiguity but is intentionally not repeated as the next carrier.
Post-Freeze Possible-Worlds Study 01 demonstrates the failure mode where environment begins carrying possibility through destination/adventure spectacle.
accessibility: No accessibility or responsive claim is made; this is pre-render scenario architecture.
invalid_or_superseded_attempts: destination-spectacle Possible-Worlds Study 01 as a role solution

requires: L-231 Website Identity Master 01 remains frozen
L-234 diagnostic role boundary remains active
constrains: Any later Alternate website-role image-generation packet
Any later Alternate website-role scenario selection

known_integration_sensitivities: The preferred market carrier can become lifestyle advertising if lighting, styling or produce detail becomes more important than the interruption.
The practical disruption must remain low-stakes enough that more than one next response stays credible.
Background people must have independent trajectories; nobody should pose as if awaiting Alternate's intervention.
The camera must preserve encountered presence rather than protagonist hero framing.
If the tipped-object device becomes visually cute, precious or narratively loaded, the prop will replace the circumstance mechanism.
explicit_non_authority: No new image is selected or generated.
The market/basket carrier is not a frozen Alternate world, costume, prop or brand motif.
No website production candidate or site/public change.
No app UI, runtime or product-semantic authority.
No Canonical or Mediate authority change.
No automatic resumption of Reference-17/Stage work.

director_review_surface.entry_point: No new visual surface exists; the next eligible visual review surface would be one later render made from this frozen scenario mechanism.
director_review_surface.what_to_review: Whether a later still leaves materially different next human responses believable while preserving the exact Alternate identity and keeping circumstance, not spectacle, in support.
